current_activity: The 49th Infantry Division holds the Dutch-Belgian border line east of the 275th Division on the LXXXI Corps north wing
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 5 p. 98: "These two divisions comprising General Schack's northern wing were the 49th and 275th Infantry Divisions"; p. 103: "The 275th Division was to stick close to the river while the 49th Division held the line farther east". Event definition: the order of the LXXXI Corps commander on 12 September (p. 103: "On 12 September he appealed unsuccessfully to the Seventh Army commander"). Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Maastricht with a precision of 25 km, because the line ran east along the border from the Meuse near Lanaye. Location approximate: a sector point. Location support: CMH names the Meuse at Lanaye and the border line. Commander: unknown.
